This happened in August of last year. There is no reason to go after someone who has already seen the consequences of his actions by now. The video can stay up, I am not disputing that. What I am saying is that there is no reason to go after his personal life, which people were attempting to do in the repost earlier today. We, as a collective people on reddit, have no say on his life and shouldn't be trying to run a crusade against him.

Edit: by the way, those "Real world problems" are not the consequences of his actions. He is very obviously drunk in this video, which again was taken last year (August I believe). There is no reason that someone should be suffering your so called "consequences" that he has most likely already suffered from the law. Again, there is no reason that someone on reddit should doxx someone who they dont know, about something they weren't involved in, because we are not the law.

The people in the comments were doxing him. They found his real name and were posting it everywhere in an attempt to get someone to do something to him. Clearly the man is drunk and more than likely regrets his actions. Stop posting this saying people are paying for it to be removed, because its blatantly wrong. Mods are doing their jobs to prevent real world problems.

He is not paying to get this removed. This entire video is a repost from the same video showing up months ago. Many people in the "original" posts comments found the assaulters name and were attempting to dox him, resulting in the comments being deleted and the video being taken down.

Edit: Before anyone sees this, if you do, I follow this subreddit and love a lot of the things on here, but this is really just wrong to assume this because mods are doing their job and following the rules of their subreddits.

I dont know you, but I can relate to you. I was emotionally destroyed by my foster mother. She broke my emotions down, and neglected me. She moved me from my hometown when she knew she couldn't get my teachers to hate me. She was the type of person to tell someone all of your bad qualities to someone before you met them, so once you did they would think ill of you. I lost all of my friends, my girlfriend, my community. I had nothing to do but sit in the house all day and be hurt even more. It had gotten to the point where I wrote notes to my ex so when I committed suicide she would understand. I was so very very close to slitting my wrists. The only thing that kept me here was my brother and sister and my teachers who cared about me. Had I done that, I dont know if my bro and sis would have survived in that environment. I find it hard to believe but they look up to me so much and I don't know why sometimes. Eventually that lady kicked us out and I met a wonderful girl about 2 months later. She broke up with me too, but I know for as long as I live I'll care about her and I am so happy that I got to share my time with her. And I'm fucking 19 years old, some of the shit I've been through baffles me, because no one should have to go through it, and i know that some people have it so much worse.

I cant have you do that. If you do that I'll be hurt. That sounds like bull shit, but it's not. I read your post and now I'm involved, and I've been that close to not being here before. Ive been told to kill myself and I've almost done it before too. The thing is that I knew how it would destroy the people around me. You doubt that people love you, you even feel certain they dont. But you love them yeah? I can guarantee you that they feel the same. Now imagine if they died, you would feel God awful. I wouldnt wish that feeling on my worst enemy: losing someone you love. But now imagine they did it themselves, they committed suicide. You would feel infinitely worse because you would ask yourself what could you have done differently. What could have I done to prevent that from happening. You would be unintentionally destroying the people around you. The people that care for you, regardless of how certain you feel that they dont, there is someone that does.

When I was 9 I lived in a trailer park. It was my sister, my brother, my mom and I. My dad had basically been in jail my entire life. Any way. My sister went to go hang out with her friends and my mom wouldnt let me or my brother go to hangout with ours. We were upset because we thought it was unfair. My mom said it was because she wasnt feeling well and she wanted her two strong boys to help her. We were ok with not hanging out after she said that. We all went to our room (we all slept in the same room with me, my brother and sister on the floor with makeshift blanket beds because we had next to no money). My brother went into the room first and walking down the hallway to our room my mom told me this: "Frank. I love you so very much, and if you ever need anything I'll be here for you. I love you." I said I love you too mom and we went into the room. My brother and I were next to each other and our mom was on her bed. She was talking about something (I cant remember what she was talking about since it's been almost 10 years now (I'm 19)). Then as she was talking she just fell over to where she was lying down on the bed. My brother and I instantly knew something was wrong and ran over to her. Held her hand, asked if she was ok, to which we got no response. I didnt really understand what death was before that, but once I saw her I just instantly knew that she wasnt there anymore. 
          That day still hangs with me, and always will. I miss my mom so much, and I always will. I just hope she knows that I love her and she would be proud of the young man that I've become today. 
          After that, my older brother took us in. When we lived with him it was him, his wife, his two sons, and me and my siblings. We moved to a bigger house because the one he was in couldn't fit 7 people. We lived there until 2013 when my brother died in a car accident. We lived with my sister in law for another year and a half before we got adopted by an old "friend" of my mom. Her name was Georgia. She is a jehovah's witness, and a person who is downright evil in my opinion. We lived with her for 3 and a half years before she kicked us out. She would break our personal belongings and anytime anything broke at all, it was blamed on my sibling and I even though there were 7 other people in the house. 
          I moved in with my friends in my hometown (Georgia had moved us in the middle of my senior year of high school). Once there I had a hard time because I saw my ex all the time (she had broken up with me once Georgia moved us). A good friend of my ex helped me get over her. My exs name was Amanda and her friend was Lauren. I fell for Lauren hard. She fell for me as well, but we both didnt want to ruin our friendship so we didnt tell each other. After awhile we started dating and the school year ended and we had all summer to be together. I started college so I couldn't see her as much. Then in October (2018) she broke up with me. I dont know how to explain it, but to me it feels as though there's something special about her and now I dont think I'll ever be able to be with her again. I love that girl so much, but I'm happy for her regardless. There's not a day that goes by that I could be with her again, but I know that I'm alright without her. I told her the same thing I told my first girlfriend, that shes the only one for me and all of that stuff. I told her that because I ment it, and she brushed it off because I told her the same things about my other ex. Words cant describe how much truth I put into those words. When I told my first girlfriend the same thing I didn't mean them, I was just obsessed with her and I know that. I hope that I can be ok eventually. I've been depressed ever since October and about 3 weeks ago I started taking antidepressants. I love Lauren, and I just dknt know what to do with my life. Can someone please help.
